component.name: Photos for Proton
component.summary: Unofficial client for Proton Drive Photos

description.p: Photos for Proton is an unofficial, open-source client for Proton Drive Photos, built on Proton's own Drive SDK and end-to-end encrypted. Browse the timeline and albums, search by date, name, label or what a photo shows, upload and import, edit, and share. It is not affiliated with Proton AG.
The library also appears as a Proton Photos entry in the file manager, where photos can be opened and new ones added.
